newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 14 day repo tender at three pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 14 day repo tender at three pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent.
A 74.0 billion-mark repo pact expires on Wednesday. The repo rate has been set at 3.00 percent since last August.
Funds will be credited to accounts tomorrow and the securities have to be repurchased on February 5, the Bundesbank said in a statement.
